creator: TDD
use_case: DIA adversarial ML defense and secure intelligence inference
business_goal: Operate a measurable-security architecture for air-gapped intelligence inference, secure evidence retrieval, and agentic triage with explicit human oversight.
responsibilities: reduce attack success probability across named adversarial ML threat categories
preserve temporal and epistemic channel separation
enforce human approval for consequential deception content generation
maintain immutable audit records for policy, routing, and output decisions
stop or narrow scope when policy thresholds are exceeded
memory_requirements: limited-memory operational window with cryptographic purge at window close

constraints.tech_stack: air-gapped inference + zero-trust micro-segmentation + PQC transport
constraints.budget: institutional / bounded by authorized deployment program
constraints.latency: detection and honeypot routing faster than human reaction time; deception content generation gated by human authorization
constraints.security_privacy: role-based access control, signed policy artifacts, PQC transport, hardware roots of trust, immutable audit logging

success_criteria: Named threats are addressed by probability-reducing controls, deception content cannot generate without explicit authorization, and forecast material remains permanently separated from observed evidence.

security_posture.residual_risk_statement: No architecture eliminates all attack success; controls reduce probability, increase detection, and limit blast radius.

content_constraints: No actionable intelligence about real U.S. or allied capabilities or vulnerabilities
No disinformation about real persons or ongoing operations
No content incompatible with applicable treaty obligations

synthesis_constraints: No silent mixing of archive/live evidence with forecast evidence
Composite provenance record required on synthesized output
Forecast section must remain enclosed in a quarantine wrapper
